stages.effectText: Restores HP of allies, bouncing between 3 allies. Healing reduced by 15% per bounce.

Can deploy a Reconstruction on the ground within Attack Range that can only be healed by Mon3tr; the Reconstruction grants surrounding allies +20% ATK; when the Reconstruction receives healing from itself or Mon3tr, it performs an additional healing bounce that does not weaken

Can deploy a Reconstruction on the ground within Attack Range that can only be healed by Mon3tr; the Reconstruction grants surrounding allies +25% ATK; when the Reconstruction receives healing from itself or Mon3tr, it performs an additional healing bounce that does not weaken, and the next bounce will not weaken either
